name: GD Agent Control
description: Lets an AI agent drive the game (menus, levels, screenshots, mods) over localhost TCP JSON lines.

port.name: Control port
port.description: Localhost TCP port for agent commands (JSON lines). Restart the game after changing it.

prevent-pause.name: Never pause on focus loss
prevent-pause.description: Keep levels running when the window loses focus, even without an RL client. Agents can also toggle this at runtime.

log-commands.name: Log commands
log-commands.description: Write each agent command (except ping and scene) to the Geode log.
